as_read: One small positive 30 day RCT of Rheum palmatum root extract on intestinal transit, dosed by rhein-equivalent content the labels do not print.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: intestinal transit (named primary endpoint in open full text)
studies_to_add.quote: Stool frequency and consistency, and perceived change in transit problem, transit speed and difficulty in evacuating, investigated by validated questionnaires, were improved in both groups of RE-treated volunteers compared to placebo.

stop_list: Dose fields hold rhein-equivalent mg for 36499011; they can't express that labels print 500 mg extract with no anthraquinone content.
clinician_items: 36499011: open full text says the number of subjects complaining of diarrhea or loose stools increased significantly in the 25 mg rhein-equivalent group; abstract calls 30 days safe even at the higher dose.
stored_rating_note: positive_weak fits the single trial. Already rests on 36499011 alone; the label amount isn't comparable to the stored dose, which the stored text already says.
unread_notes: Full text of 36499011 opened for design, dose, primary endpoint and funding passages only. Others abstracts, cut at 1100 characters, used only to place them outside the labels. Search 1 was noisy (Rheum matched rheumatology); search 2 restricted to titles returned 35, first 25 reviewed by title. Formula and add-on meta-analyses (32187391, 32188181, 29672966, 27693773, 26645518, 25617260, 25453529, 28573250, 36339579) and topical trials (32693116, 33607823, 32951726) not opened, since their titles put them outside these labels.
